size-guide.title: Size guide
size-guide.intro: Measurements for our towel sizes and robes.

sections.a: Face cloth 30 × 30 cm (12 × 12 in) · Hand towel 50 × 90 cm (20 × 35 in) · Bath towel 70 × 130 cm (28 × 51 in) · Bath sheet 100 × 150 cm (39 × 59 in).
Chest: XS 76–81 cm · S 86–91 cm · M 96–101 cm · L 106–111 cm · XL 116–121 cm. Between sizes? Size up for a roomier wrap.
Bath mats are 50 × 80 cm (20 × 31 in). Beach and hammam towels are 100 × 180 cm (39 × 71 in).

care.title: Care guide
care.intro: A little care keeps natural fibres soft and absorbent for years.

sections.a: Wash new towels once on their own at 40°C to open up the loops and remove any loose fibres.
Wash at 40°C with similar colours. Skip fabric softener — it coats the fibres and reduces absorbency.
Tumble dry on low or line dry, then shake out for extra fluff. Linen likes to come out slightly damp.
Never pull a loose loop — snip it level with the surface using small scissors.

buying-guide.title: Buying guide
buying-guide.intro: How to choose by feel, weight and material.

sections.a: Grams per square metre — the weight of a fabric. Higher GSM towels feel plusher; lower GSM dries faster.

sections.q: Which feel is right for me?
sections.a: Light & airy suits warm climates and quick drying. Plush & indulgent is for slow, spa-like mornings. Try the quiz if you’re unsure.
Turkish cotton is light and quick to dry, Egyptian cotton is long-fibred and plush, and organic cotton is grown without synthetic pesticides.
